description: MAGIC Datastore is a data resource listed in Free GIS Data (rtwilson), a curated list of free geographic datasets under the section "United Kingdom (UK)", published or maintained by the publisher of magic.defra.gov.uk. A wide range of datasets for the UK including boundaries, pipelines, urban areas, health and safety and more. Many entries in the database are links to other sites and some require registration. Coverage: United Kingdom (national); layers named in the list entry only. The list files it under "United Kingdom (UK)". The entry links to magic.defra.gov.uk. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the list entry (source page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure mapping and planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-free-gis-data-list.
